basics.name: Gittaveni Sidhartha
basics.label: AI Engineer | Generative AI & LLM Systems | Data Scientist
basics.summary: AI Engineer with 5 years of experience building production LLM, agentic, and RAG systems, with a disciplined focus on evaluation, verification, and quality gates that confirm AI output before it reaches users. Skeptical by default, I design eval suites, verification harnesses, and CI-wired automated checks that turn 'it seems to work' into defensible evidence across retrieval, summarization, and voice-agent workflows. Track record of measurable impact — from 90% faster regulated-document search to a $5.28M productivity lift — by raising the standard for what 'working' means.

visa.notes: Currently on F-1 OPT (STEM) valid until November 2027. H-1B cap-exempt possible via university/nonprofit. Open to TN (Canada/Mexico) and E-3 (Australia) if applicable. No EAD-only roles.

work.name: AstraZeneca
highlights: Lexi — Agentic RAG Assistant for Regulated Documents: Architected an end-to-end RAG system delivering accurate, traceable answers from large internal regulated document repositories (SOPs, work instructions, policies), replacing unreliable keyword-based search across the organization.
Engineered a multi-signal hybrid retrieval pipeline (fuzzy matching, BPE token-based search, vector similarity) that reliably resolves document IDs, partial filenames, and natural-language queries.
Built a hierarchical document preprocessing framework converting raw files into structured, section-chunked markdown for precise context injection into LLMs.
Implemented deterministic section injection, resolving LLM-generated reference tags to exact source text at runtime for 100% response grounding and full audit traceability.
Deployed a scalable, container-based architecture on Azure — Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Blob Storage, and LangGraph orchestration — supporting hundreds of concurrent users.
Impact: Reduced regulatory document search time by 90%, projected to save 3,750 hours/week at full scale with zero compliance violations and a 30–40% reduction in SME interruption overhead.

HCP Summarization & Insights with LLMs: Evaluated LLaMA, Phi-3, and Claude 3.7 Sonnet for HCP-level summarization across commercial, behavioral, and publication data; shipped a production insights dashboard generating actionable summaries for sales teams.
Data Engineering for Model Deployment: Built production pipelines automating data processing and model deployment on AWS, integrated with BI tools for real-time decision-making and reporting.
Impact: Sharpened understanding of HCP behavior and engagement drivers, enabling more effective field strategies and targeting.

HCP Early Adoption Modeling (Saphnelo): Designed adoption propensity models (clustering, classification, regression) by analyzing competitor prescribing patterns and forecasting SubQ uptake. Developed production-ready data pipelines using Spark and Python for real-time data processing and model inference.

work.name: Stealth AI Startup (VoiceLink — Voice AI Automation Platform)
highlights: Architected and shipped a production-grade voice AI platform for restaurants deployed on GCP, integrating Deepgram (ASR), Claude/Gemini Vertex AI (LLM), and ElevenLabs/Gemini/Chirp 3 (TTS) to automate inbound/outbound calls — achieving sub-2-second response latency and a 95% call success rate.
Implemented RAG using Vertex AI over restaurant-specific data for accurate order handling and menu understanding, with full POS system integration for end-to-end automation.

Impact: Eliminated human dependency for restaurant order management, saving an estimated $19,200/year per location — a model scalable across enterprise restaurant chains for millions in potential annual savings.
